_note: YouTube video ids whose custom thumbnail was set through vidiq_update_video_thumbnail (13 Nov 2026 catch-up). YouTube rate-limits thumbnail updates (~10 in a row), so the rest is retried in batches.
_how: Catch-up: take pending in publish-date order (vidiq_user_videos private, scheduledPublishAt), vidiq_update_video_thumbnail(channelId UCAq5URh_O2gbg4bFFwBWfdg, videoId, thumbnail), move the id to applied. New uploads: every uploaded360.json entry with a videoId that is not in applied goes to pending with https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eliassaoe/findlinkai/thumbs/<slug>.jpg if it exists on the thumbs branch, else .png.
